Restore multiple users from the Trash at once. If one user fails to restore, the entire
operation fails. You can restore a maximum of 100 users per request at a rate limit of 50
calls per minute. Restoring users from the Trash doesn't change the user's status.
Restored users still have a "disabled" status and can't log in. Refer to Restoring Users
from Trash for more information. Requires "Grant resource - Write" API permission.
